newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sept bad-cheque rate rises to 0.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sept bad-cheque rate rises to 0.62 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio rose to 0.62 percent in September, up from 0.59 percent in August, the central bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
Bad cheques totalled 84,612, or 0.62 percent of September's total, with a value of T$17 billion, or 0.41 percent of the value of all cheques written, the bank said.
The monthly bad-cheque ratio hit a 10-year high of 0.80 percent in October 1995, it said.
The bank attributed the rising number of bad cheques in 1995 to a slow economy and weakness in property and stock markets.
